It answers the owner's recovery request on main #307 ([6136156988](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136156988), [6136210973](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136210973)) under the implementation decision [6136231457](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6136231457) ("register each checkpoint once through the existing delivery procedure, with a per-file manifest"). A reader can find, by commit and digest, every still-local artifact of this session (renderer versions 1–9, binders of rounds 1–14 with logs, the round-4 triage probes, proof-packet round 5–6 verification files, the main #151 museum review probes, the torus companion work, notes) before re-deriving any of it. Scope: engineering (byte custody and indexing); scientific effect NONE.
